content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Wichita

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus defined years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with significantly more hours leading projects. Review PMI's exact education and experience thresholds, then gather documentation of your work history to confirm you meet the baseline before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp—instructor-led sessions delivered online nationwide. Attend all scheduled classes, participate in real-time Q&A with active certified practitioners, and complete course materials covering the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains at your own pace between sessions.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, create your PMI account and submit your official application, including your education and project-experience details. Pay PMI's exam registration fee and wait for approval—typically completed within days—so you can schedule your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP® Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice tests, and study guides to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in the Wichita area, sit for the 180-minute computer-based exam, and receive your pass/fail result on the same day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP® is valid for three years. Throughout that cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, volunteering, or contributing to the profession. Before expiration, renew your credential by submitting your PDU log and renewal fee to PMI.
